//: The desktop app (ADR 0097), as the offline gate typechecks it. Electrobun 2 ships its SDK through its own toolchain rather than npm, so the three modules that import it -- the composition root, the view's bridge and the view's entry -- are left to tsconfig.electrobun.json, which `task ci:desktop-check` runs after `electrobun prepare` has projected the SDK. Everything else here is written against rpc.ts and handlers/shell.ts and checked in every gate.
